name: Vitamin B12 (cobalamin)

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: A cobalt-containing vitamin required for methionine synthase and methylmalonyl-CoA mutase. Depletion is common on metformin, on acid suppression, and on plant-only diets.

systems.note: Repletion of a cofactor required for erythropoiesis; the intended effect.
Also repletes the cofactor whose deficiency causes subacute combined degeneration.
Supplementation normalises the serum B12 level while a functional deficiency may persist; methylmalonic acid is the discriminating test.

monitors.why: The direct index of intake, though it normalises before functional repletion.
Macrocytosis resolves with repletion and is the accessible functional readout.
